title: Gaza Health Ministry reports war death toll has passed 43,000
body:
On 28 October 2024, the Palestinian Health Ministry in Gaza said that the death toll in the war had passed 43,000, with more than half of those killed being women and children. According to the ministry, at least 43,020 people had been killed and 101,110 wounded since the war began on 7 October 2023. The count included 96 people who arrived at Gaza hospitals over the previous two days. The ministry does not distinguish between militants and civilians.

Israel has repeatedly questioned the ministry's figures, while the United Nations has described them as reliable. The Israeli military says Hamas and other militants use hospitals and civilian sites for military purposes, which Palestinian medical officials deny. In the same period, Israeli forces detained 100 suspected Hamas militants during a raid on Kamal Adwan Hospital in Beit Lahiya, according to Israel.

The war began when Hamas-led militants killed about 1,200 people in Israel on 7 October 2023, mostly civilians, according to Israeli figures reported by the Associated Press, and abducted about 250 people.
